ops.text: For smaller planets, where the atmospheric signal is weaker, injection-recovery tests indicate that neglecting unocculted heterogeneity on K-dwarf hosts can bias the retrieved metallicity substantially, and that priors on the coverage fractions from contemporaneous photometry remove much of this bias (Garside et al., 2026).

new_bib.text: E. Garside, T. Brierley, L. Pemberton, O. Corcoran, and M. Dyson (2026). Unocculted spots and faculae bias the metallicities of small planets around K dwarfs: injection-recovery tests and monitoring-informed retrievals. arXiv e-prints.
